name: Bumper Island V.2
author: garrettmmoore
description:
Bump as many enemies off of the island and try to get the highest score before the enemies bump you off the island. 

Controls (Keyboard):
- "J" to jump.
- "Spacebar" to use powerups.
- "P" to pause the game.
- WASD to move the player (ball) and rotate the camera.

Powerups:
- Green: Shoot unlimited heat-seeking projectiles.
- Yellow: Extra strength when bumping into enemies.
- Red: Jump and slam into the ground with extra force to create an impact that blasts enemies away.
